method: Affine inverse remap in assumed native Gauss-Kruger projection from four actually labelled source corners; each corner held out against the other three
assumed_src_crs: EPSG:4284 (Pulkovo 1942), not explicitly confirmed on scan
caveat: Grid-fit and leave-one-out residuals are not absolute geographic accuracy. Picks are approximate; all controls are on frame, not surveyed landmarks. Datum assumption, paper/scanner distortion and interior alignment remain unverified. Provisional, not field-grade.
